messages.content: I am an admin, I need all the access logs, page size set to 50.

function.name: audit_log_api_AuditLogApi_get_access_logs
function.description: Retrieve a list of access log entries from the audit log. This function allows for paginated access and filtered queries based on criteria such as user ID, action type, and date range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

offset.description: The starting point from which to return results, used for pagination. It specifies the offset of the first log entry to return.

query.description: A query string to filter the access logs based on specific criteria, such as 'user_id:1001' to filter logs for user ID 1001 or 'action:login' for login events.

pageSize.description: The number of log entries to return in one call. Values must be between 1 and 100, inclusive.

startDate.description: The start date from which to retrieve access logs, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Logs will be fetched starting from 00:00:00 of this date.

endDate.description: The end date until which to retrieve access logs, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Logs will be fetched up to 23:59:59 of this date.

function.name: get_alerts
function.description: Retrieve a list of all alert configurations from the event settings API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_disabled.description: If set to true, the response will include alert configurations that are currently disabled.

filter.description: A string to filter the alert configurations by name or description.

limit.description: The maximum number of alert configurations to retrieve.

offset.description: The number of alert configurations to skip before starting to collect the result set.

function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_get_shareable_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieve a list of shareable API tokens associated with the user's account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
